error_direction_rationale: The kernel is an exact BigInt recompute of two differences and one chained digest over declared integers: no rounding, threshold approximation, cap or floor enters the arithmetic, so there is no directional arithmetic error to declare. The two honesty gaps (declared balances may not be real; the event log may be incomplete) are not arithmetic errors of the recompute -- they are carried as declared boundaries by evidence.reads_no_ledger / balances_caller_asserted and the unrepresented_known rows below, not scored as fill quality.

derived_from.clause_path: staff response facts: Registered Wallets, Tokenization Instruction, Digital Omnibus Account (reflects the sum of all Tokenized Entitlements held in all Registered Wallets), Factory mint, de-tokenization burn, LedgerScan as DTC's official books and records, Cede and Co., double-spend lock; request letter II.a Operational Flow, II.c Conditions Requiring Reversal, II.e Design Controls (No Double Spend, Only Participants May Register Wallets, Transfers Only to Registered Wallets, Override Keys); three-year withdrawal term

branches.clause: staff response facts: the Digital Omnibus Account reflects the sum of all Tokenized Entitlements held in all Registered Wallets
branches.branch: The omnibus position is reconciled against the sum of every declared wallet balance; no wallet is dropped from the sum, including rule-violating ones.
branches.note: fixtures reconciled-clean-two-wallets and wallet-leg-mismatch pin the sum both ways.

branches.clause: staff response facts: the Digital Omnibus Account reflects the sum of all Tokenized Entitlements held in all Registered Wallets
branches.branch: The wallets-leg difference is omnibus_balance minus sum_wallets, exact integer, signed.
branches.note: carried at omnibus_vs_wallets_delta; within/without stated in legs.omnibus_vs_wallets_within_tolerance.

branches.clause: staff response facts: LedgerScan constitutes DTC's official books and records; the tokenized position is held through the book-entry system (Cede and Co.)
branches.branch: The custodial leg is omnibus_balance minus the declared book-entry position, exact integer, signed.
branches.note: fixture book-leg-mismatch pins a nonzero book delta.

branches.clause: declared input contract: tolerance_units is a caller-declared non-negative integer band around exact deltas
branches.branch: Each computable leg is compared inclusively (|delta| <= tolerance); the verdict flip sits exactly at the band edge.
branches.note: fixtures tolerance-edge-inclusive and tolerance-edge-one-below pin both sides of the edge.

branches.clause: request letter II.e Design Controls: Transfers Only to Registered Wallets (and Only Participants May Register Wallets)
branches.branch: Under the dtc_dts profile an unregistered wallet holding a positive balance contradicts the registered-only rule: flagged UNREGISTERED_WALLET_BALANCE, never dropped from the sum, and the verdict is MISMATCH even when both deltas tie.
branches.note: fixtures unregistered-holder-forces-mismatch-under-dtc-profile, generic-profile-unregistered-holder-reconciles (rule is profile-scoped) and unregistered-zero-balance-not-a-rule-breach (fires on holding, not on registration state).

branches.clause: staff response facts: Factory mint on a Tokenization Instruction; de-tokenization burn
branches.branch: Declared mint and burn events are counted by kind and chained in seq order.
branches.note: event_counts.mint / event_counts.burn; chained alongside the other kinds.

branches.clause: request letter II.e Design Controls: Override Keys; request letter II.c Conditions Requiring Reversal
branches.branch: Declared forced transfers (override/reversal movements) are counted separately and chained; their presence is recorded without changing the balance arithmetic.
branches.note: fixture forced-transfer-present-still-reconciled pins a verdict that stays RECONCILED with a forced transfer on the log.

branches.clause: declared input contract: the event log is sequenced and each entry digests the previous entry (tamper-evident ordering over what was declared)
branches.branch: The chained SHA-256 head over JCS-canonical {prev, seq, kind, amount, wallet_label} entries in seq order; null when no events are declared.
branches.note: head expectations in the conformance fixtures are recomputed through node:crypto, independent of the kernel's inlined core.

branches.clause: declared input contract: a receipt must state exactly what it could and could not reconcile
branches.branch: When neither leg is computable (no omnibus balance, or both other legs absent) the verdict is UNDECIDABLE with every absent-input flag named; absent-but-well-formed inputs are never refused.
branches.note: fixture undecidable-nothing-declared pins the empty declaration; the absent flags ride in warnings.

branches.clause: declared input contract: profile is one of the two declared reconciliation profiles (dtc_dts, generic_omnibus); the pinned letter grounds the DTS profile only
branches.branch: A caller declaring an unknown profile is refused before any arithmetic.

branches.clause: declared input contract: as_of is a caller-declared YYYY-MM-DD snapshot label (no clock is read)
branches.branch: An as_of outside the date shape is refused rather than reinterpreted.

branches.clause: declared input contract: tolerance_units is a non-negative integer count of base units
branches.branch: A negative or fractional tolerance is refused rather than clamped.

branches.clause: declared input contract: balances and amounts are exact integer base units as decimal strings; a JSON number is never a decimal string here (floats included)
branches.branch: A JSON number in any balance or amount field is refused before any coercion and never echoed.

branches.clause: declared input contract: units are exact non-negative integers; tokenized entitlements reconcile in whole base units
branches.branch: A decimal point or exponent in a balance or amount string is refused as fractional.

branches.clause: declared input contract: balances are non-negative integer base units; a signed string is located before any parse
branches.branch: A leading minus in a balance or amount string is refused as negative.

branches.clause: declared input contract: a balance string is a bare non-negative integer decimal (leading zeros collapse via normalization)
branches.branch: An empty or non-digit balance string is refused as malformed.

branches.clause: declared input contract: a wallet or event entry carries its balance or amount member; absence is a malformed entry, not a zero
branches.branch: A wallet entry with no balance member is refused (an absent balance would be silently mistakable for a zero balance).

branches.clause: declared input contract: wallets is an array of per-wallet entries
branches.branch: A non-array wallets value is refused before iteration.

branches.clause: declared input contract: each wallets[] entry is an object
branches.branch: A non-object wallet entry is refused.

branches.clause: declared input contract: labels are opaque handles matching [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}, never identity fields
branches.branch: A label outside the charset or length bound is refused.

branches.clause: declared input contract: wallet labels are unique identifiers within one declaration (a duplicate would double-count or alias a balance)
branches.branch: A second wallet entry reusing an earlier label is refused.

branches.clause: declared input contract: labels are opaque handles; an identifier-shaped label is PII and is refused before the charset check, never echoed
branches.branch: An email-shaped wallet or event label is refused as pii_email_shaped_label.

branches.clause: declared input contract: labels are opaque handles; an identifier-shaped label is PII and is refused before the charset check, never echoed
branches.branch: A 20-character LEI-shaped label is refused as pii_lei_shaped_label.

branches.clause: declared input contract: labels are opaque handles; an identifier-shaped label is PII and is refused before the charset check, never echoed
branches.branch: An IBAN-shaped label is refused as pii_iban_shaped_label on wallets and on event entries alike.

branches.clause: declared input contract: labels are opaque handles; a long digit run is account-number-shaped PII, refused before the charset check, never echoed
branches.branch: A 9-or-more-digit label is refused as pii_account_number_shaped_label.

branches.clause: request letter II.e: Only Participants May Register Wallets -- the registered state is a declared boolean fact per wallet
branches.branch: A registered member that is not a boolean is refused rather than coerced.

branches.clause: declared input contract: events is an array of log entries
branches.branch: A non-array events value is refused before iteration.

branches.clause: declared input contract: each events[] entry is an object
branches.branch: A non-object event entry is refused.

branches.clause: declared input contract: seq is a non-negative integer position in the log; the chain is order-sensitive
branches.branch: A negative, fractional, or otherwise non-integer seq is refused.

branches.clause: declared input contract: seq values are unique within the log (a duplicate would fork the chain)
branches.branch: A second event reusing an earlier seq is refused.

branches.clause: staff response facts + request letter II.c/II.e: the log records mint, burn, forced transfer (override/reversal) and transfer movements only
branches.branch: An event kind outside the four-value enum is refused.

branches.clause: declared input contract: event amounts obey the same exact-integer decimal-string domain as balances (a number, or an absent member, is refused)
branches.branch: An event amount that is a JSON number or is missing entirely is refused.

branches.clause: staff response facts: the omnibus/wallet/book state lives in DTC's systems (LedgerScan as official books and records); this kernel reads none of them
branches.branch: Whether each declared wallet balance is the real on-chain/book balance is outside the input entirely.

assumption_of_use.value: per-wallet balances, omnibus balance and book-entry position as of the declared date
assumption_of_use.source: the custodian's own records (LedgerScan / book-entry statements) pasted by the declaring party
assumption_of_use.owner: the declaring participant's operations desk, which attests the pasted aggregates before the receipt is relied on

branches.clause: staff response facts: LedgerScan constitutes DTC's official books and records; the book-entry position is a custodian-side fact
branches.branch: Whether the declared book_entry_position matches DTC's books is outside the input.

assumption_of_use.value: the book-entry position of the omnibus holding as of the declared date
assumption_of_use.owner: the custodian's reconciliation team supplying the book figure

branches.clause: request letter II.c Conditions Requiring Reversal + II.e Override Keys: reversals and overrides are recorded movements; the kernel chains only what was declared
branches.branch: A withheld, backdated or off-log event is invisible: the chained head covers exactly the declared entries, so it proves ordering and coverage of the declared log, not completeness of the underlying history.
branches.note: No runtime path can exist: log completeness is a property of the custodian's systems, not of the declared shape. A withheld event leaves the arithmetic self-consistent, so the error lands toward no-finding (RECONCILED on an incomplete log). events_counted and event_log_head carry exactly what was chained; manual review treats the head as an integrity marker over the declared log only.

branches.clause: staff response facts: the reconciliation relations hold in DTC's systems; this kernel recomputes the arithmetic over caller-asserted aggregates and reads no ledger
branches.branch: All three legs can tie exactly while every underlying record is wrong: the kernel proves the arithmetic over the declaration, never that the declaration is true.
branches.note: Inherent to a declared-state recompute, not closable by more arithmetic. evidence.balances_caller_asserted, evidence.reads_no_ledger and the node page scope note carry the boundary on every receipt. The out_of_scope_by_input rows above name the owners of the underlying facts; this row records that the residual risk points toward no-finding.
